'''Water Surge''' is a [[Water spells|water]]-based [[Surge spells|surge spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 85 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the strongest water spell in the game.

==Damage ==
Water Surge has a base maximum hit of 22 which increases as the player unlocks additional surge spells, up to 24 at level 95 Magic.

As with all combat spells, Water Surge's maximum hit is also increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As a water-based spell, Water Surge's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to water]].
